name: Setup
description: Configure Evyasys for this project — choose PM tool (Local / Azure DevOps / JIRA / GitHub Projects) and notification channel (None / Teams / Slack / WhatsApp / Email), then collect and encrypt credentials. Safe to re-run to update config or rotate secrets.

name: TrainDocs
description: Scan the entire codebase and generate 20 quality-gate documents into .evyasys/docs/ covering architecture, standards, patterns, testing, security, design system, UI/UX standards, and more. Pass --retrain to regenerate only docs affected by recent git changes.

name: CreateStory
description: Draft a complete business story from project context — asks clarifying questions one at a time, handles Epic filing, pushes to Azure DevOps and notifies Teams on approval.

name: CreateSubtask
description: Decompose a story into developer-ready tasks — presents 2-3 breakdown strategies for team approval, then writes 3-8 tasks each ≤ 1 day. Pass StoryID e.g. EVYA-1042.

name: StartDev
description: Kick off development — structured technical brainstorm (3+ approaches, team approval) then branch/PR/DoR/dependency gates. Transitions ADO to In Progress. Pass StoryID.

name: ReviewDev
description: Independent code review — AC coverage, correctness, security, YAGNI, test quality. Evidence-based findings with file+line citations. Critical issues block FinishDev. Pass StoryID.

name: FinishDev
description: Wrap development — AC audit, DoD checklist, diff scope check, Dev Summary. Transitions ADO to Ready for QA. Pass StoryID.

name: StartQa
description: Generate a comprehensive test plan — confirms environment and data first, then writes AC-driven positive/negative/edge/regression/non-functional cases. Transitions ADO to In QA. Pass StoryID.

name: FinishQa
description: Release sign-off — validates all TC outcomes recorded, no P0/P1 defects open, drafts plain-language release notes. Transitions ADO to Done. Pass StoryID.

name: Update
description: Update the Evyasys plugin to the latest version — clears the plugin cache and shows the three reinstall commands. Project config and credentials are not affected.

name: GenerateReleaseNote
description: Compile a branded PDF release notes document from one or more completed stories — groups by Epic, consolidates quality gates, proposes version from history, generates PDF. Pass story IDs e.g. EVYA-1042 EVYA-1043.
